title: Score d'encéphalopathie des cellules effectrices immunitaires (ICE)
diseases: Syndrome de neurotoxicité associé aux cellules effectrices immunitaires (ICANS)
formula:
To calculate the ICE Score, add the points for each variable:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Orientation | | |
| Year | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Month | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| City | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Hospital | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Naming | | |
| Ability to name three objects (E.g., point to clock, pen, button) | None | 0 |
| One | 1 | |
| Two | 2 | |
| All three | 3 | |
| Following Commands | | |
| Ability to follow simple commands (E.g., “show me 2 fingers” or “close your eyes and stick out your tongue”) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Writing | | |
| Ability to write a standard sentence (E.g., “Our national bird is the bald eagle”) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Attention | | |
| Ability to count backwards from 100 by 10 | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |

how_to_use.why:
- Facilite la reconnaissance précoce et la prise en charge rapide de la neurotoxicité, ce qui peut réduire le risque de complications sévères ou irréversibles.
- Simple, reproductible, et utilisable dans les essais cliniques comme en pratique courante.
- Favorise une gradation standardisée et la communication entre les équipes pluridisciplinaires.
- Approuvé par [ASTCT (2019)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30592986/) et alimente directement le [ICANS Consensus Grading](nabda:calc.immune-effector-cell-associated-neurotoxicity-syndrome-icans-consensus-grading-adults).
how_to_use.when:
- Use for routine assessment and serial monitoring of immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS) in adults and adolescents (≥12 years) receiving chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy.
- Apply at baseline and at regular intervals post-infusion (authors recommend every 8 hours while hospitalized after therapy).
how_to_use.pearls:
- Incorporated into the[2019 American Society for Transplantation and Cellular Therapy (ASTCT)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30592986/)consensus ICANS grading as an update to CARTOX-10, adding a receptive aphasia component.
- Not validated in patients with pre-existing neurological, sensory, or language barriers; results may be confounded by medications or comorbidities.
- Not optimized for children <12 years of age.

next_steps.advice:
For a score <10, ICANS is likely present; lower scores indicate greater severity.

- Rule out other potential causes of neurocognitive changes (e.g., sedatives, metabolic derangements, infection, stroke).
- Apply results to the [Immune Effector Cell-Associated Neurotoxicity Syndrome (ICANS) Consensus Grading for Adults](nabda:calc.immune-effector-cell-associated-neurotoxicity-syndrome-icans-consensus-grading-adults) .

more_info:
Interpretation:

| ICE Score | Severity |
| --- | --- |
| <2* | Severe |
| 2-9 | Non-severe |
| 10 | No cognitive impairment |

*Any patient with an ICE score less than 2 or with seizures is classified as severe.
short_description: Évalue la fonction neurocognitive après une thérapie par cellules CAR-T.
medium_description: Assesses neurocognitive function dans patients receiving CAR T-cell therapy.
